ei.title: Let Bears Bear the Right to Live Freely
ei.subject: 공통영어2

fullPassage: Let Bears Bear the Right to Live Freely Bears are a fascinating group of animals with eight species, all living in very different habitats around the world. Polar bears, for example, live in the Arctic, whereas Andean bears live in South America. These bears should have the freedom to live, but they are often killed when they come into contact with humans. One of the worst examples of this is bear bile farming. Brown bears in Eurasia and North America, Sun bears in Southeast Asia, and Asiatic black bears in Asia are often hunted and kept illegally for their bile, which is sold at a high price for traditional Asian medicine. Although bile farming is prohibited in many countries, it continues due to the constant demand. Governments and animal welfare organizations make persistent attempts to find these farms and rescue the bears, allowing them to live in bear sanctuaries or other safe places. Since UNESCO stated in 1978 that animals are born with the right to be respected, progress has been made in animal rights. However, some animals are still not fully protected outside the law, and need more of our attention and care.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.analysis:

✅ ③ come: when they come into contact with humans — 주어 they(복수)에 맞는 현재시제 동사로 적절
❌ ④ hunting → hunted: are often ___ and kept 는 'be동사+p.p.'의 수동태 자리로, 곰이 '사냥당하는' 대상이므로 과거분사 hunted가 옳다. 현재분사 hunting은 부적절 ←정답
det.tip: be동사 뒤에서 '~당하다'라는 수동의 의미는 과거분사(p.p.)로 씁니다. and kept와 병렬을 이루는 점도 단서입니다.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.analysis:

✅ ③ allowing: rescue the bears, allowing them to live ~ — 앞 절에 이어지는 분사구문으로 적절

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

✅ ② prohibited: bile farming is prohibited — 농장이 '금지되는' 대상이므로 수동태로 적절

✅ ④ need: some animals are ... and need more of our attention — 앞의 are와 병렬을 이루며 주어 animals(복수)에 맞는 현재시제로 적절

✅ ② prohibited: bile farming is prohibited — 농장이 '금지되는' 대상이므로 수동태로 적절
❌ ③ rescuing → rescue: make persistent attempts to find these farms and ___ the bears 에서 앞의 to find와 병렬을 이루는 (to) 원형부정사 자리이므로 rescue가 옳다. 동명사 rescuing은 부적절 ←정답
✅ ④ protected: some animals are still not fully protected — 동물이 '보호받는' 대상이므로 수동태로 적절
det.tip: attempts to find A and (to) rescue B처럼 and로 연결된 병렬 구조에서는 앞의 to부정사와 같은 형태(동사원형)로 맞춰야 합니다.

questions.passage: These bears should have the freedom to live, but they are often killed when they come into contact with humans.  One of the worst examples of this is bear bile farming.  Brown bears in Eurasia and North America, Sun bears in Southeast Asia, and Asiatic black bears in Asia are often hunted and kept illegally for their bile, which is sold at a high price for traditional Asian medicine.  Although bile farming is prohibited in many countries, it continues due to the constant demand.  Governments and animal welfare organizations make persistent attempts to find these farms and rescue the bears, allowing them to live in bear sanctuaries or other safe places.  Since UNESCO stated in 1978 that animals are born with the right to be respected, progress has been made in animal rights.

det.analysis: 본문 '... for their bile, which is sold at a high price for traditional Asian medicine.'에서 쓸개즙은 전통 아시아 의약품으로 'high price(높은 값)'에 팔린다.

det.analysis:

det.korean: 곰이 마땅히 지녀야 할 삶의 권리.
det.analysis:

- These bears(주어) + should have(조동사+동사): 이 곰들은 지녀야 한다

det.tip: '~해야 한다'는 should + 동사원형, '살아갈 자유'는 the freedom to live처럼 명사 뒤에 to부정사를 붙입니다.
